item.title: Mullenweg has returned as CEO after attempted board ouster
item.description:
📝 After a tumultuous week that saw WordPress founder Matt Mullenweg ousted from his position as CEO of WordPress. Automattic confirmed Mullenweg’s removal to TechCrunch on Wednesday, saying that Mullenweg was “currently on leave” and that Automattic’s Chief Financial Officer, Mark Davies, would lead as interim CEO with “full confidence” of the board. When TechCrunch asked Mullenweg if his comments about being back as CEO were legitimate, he promised a blog post was coming.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/12/automattic-confirms-mullenweg-has-returned-as-ceo-after-attempted-ouster-by-board/

item.title: Writing a better reality: The case for optimistic sci-fi
The Coming War on General Computation (2011)
item.description:
📝 But, tonight, I want to talk about something more important -- I want to talk about general purpose computers. And they were eminently susceptible to duplication, and so they were duplicated quickly, and widely, and this was to the great chagrin of people who made and sold software. First, they were commercially unpopular, of course, because they reduced the usefulness of the software to the legitimate purchasers, while leaving the people who took the software without paying for it untouched.
